a.lede: The week, the Windows developer said it would offer buyouts to 60,000 workers as it looks to curb costs.
a.title: Microsoft profits soar days after announcing thousands of layoffs

b.lede: Software giant reports $36.6bn in profit, beating Wall Street expectations, as Azure cloud computing division grows 48% Microsoft gained billions of dollars in stock market value Wednesday afternoon after it reported better than expected revenue and profit, just days after it offered voluntary buyouts to some 60,000 employees. The office software giant’s growth was fueled by its Azure cloud computing
b.title: Microsoft posts $92.3bn quarterly revenue after offering buyouts to 60,000 employees
